# TinyUSB license and notice evidence map

This inventory is derived from `import-manifest.json` and the preserved
upstream bytes. It records evidence and does not independently reclassify or
provide legal advice about any file.

| Destination set | Evidence | Notice status | Review |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LICENSE` | Upstream `LICENSE` at TinyUSB tag `0.21.0` | Preserved byte-for-byte | reviewed |
| `src/**` | Upstream file headers and upstream `LICENSE` | TinyUSB MIT notices preserved byte-for-byte | reviewed |

No imported upstream file was edited after the pinned commit was checked out.
Project-owned adapters and the reused keyboard parser are not part of this
map.
